description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between perplexity and GPU memory ratio as a function of the percent sequence ratio for different configurations of the PyramidInfer system. The x-axis, labeled "Percent Sequence Ratio (%)," ranges from 0 to 100 and is plotted on a linear scale. The left y-axis, labeled "Perplexity," ranges from 4.2 to 4.7 and represents the model's perplexity values. The right y-axis, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)," ranges from 40 to 90 and indicates the ratio of GPU memory usage. The plot includes four distinct lines: an orange line with circular markers representing "Perplexity," which starts at a value of approximately 4.6 at 0% sequence ratio and generally decreases to around 4.4 by 100%, with a slight increase near 80%; a blue line with circular markers for "Full Cache PPL," which begins at about 4.2 and steadily increases to approximately 4.7; a red dashed line labeled "Full Cache GPU Mem.," which remains constant at a GPU memory ratio of 60% across all sequence ratios; and a blue dashed line for "GPU Mem. Ratio," which starts at 40% and sharply increases to 90% at a sequence ratio of 60%, then remains constant. The data suggests that as the sequence ratio increases, the perplexity and GPU memory usage for the full cache configurations change, while the full cache GPU memory ratio stays constant.
